subject: Re: Kickoff: Distracting Control as our RL robustness gate
body:
Status, and one design question that needs an answer before the June sweep.

Integration: validated May 14. The demo generates correct sample images across tasks and difficulties, backgrounds pull from DAVIS as expected, and our agents run unmodified against the suite's dm_control-compatible API. Farah's nightly CI job is live on two smoke-test configurations.

Early signal from pilot runs: camera-pose distraction is by far the most damaging for our current agents -- at medium difficulty it costs 55-70% of clean-environment return, versus 20-30% for background video and under 15% for color changes.

The design question: dynamic backgrounds sample DAVIS videos, and seed handling determines whether two agents see identical distraction sequences. For a fair gate we need fixed seeds per benchmark cell. Amara has a patch; needs sign-off since it diverges from the released default behavior.

Tereza
